title: Introduce stochastic-consensus eval oracle and CI bridge for instability-aware gating
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Motivation: We see intermittent flakiness in prompt-set regressions that traditional deterministic smoke checks miss. This PR adds a stochastic consensus evaluator that runs multiple randomized perturbations/seed variations per prompt, computes a consensus distribution over binary/metric-level outcomes, and exposes a probabilistic gate for CI. The goal is to reduce false positives (single-seed noise) while surfacing true instability and persistent regressions; it also provides quarantine suggestions for cohorts with high variance. What this implements: 1) eval_harness/oracles/stochastic_consensus.py - core evaluator implementing ensemble of perturbations, aggregation functions (consensus rate, trimmed mean, bootstrap CI), and an optional seed scheduler; 2) eval_harness/ci/consensus_ci_adapter.py - adapter that converts evaluator results into CI-friendly status with configurable thresholds for consistency_rate and p_value; 3) test-suite updates: tests/unit/test_stochastic_consensus.py + a deterministic seeding harness for CI replay; 4) docs: docs/eval/stochastic_consensus.md with algorithm notes and recommended thresholds; 5) examples: examples/prompt_sets/flaky_cohort.yml and a demo notebook converted to an integration test runner; 6) CircleCI integration hook: .circleci/consensus_gate.yml to run the adapter as a post-eval gate and annotate PRs. Backwards compatibility: the new oracle is opt-in via eval config (consensus: {enabled:true}) so existing pipelines are unaffected by default. Migration: a short guide in the docs shows mapping from single-run smoke gates to consensus gates and how to tune parameters. Checklist: [x] unit tests [x] integration smoke-run [x] docs [x] Linear links [x] added deterministic-replay mode that CI can use for reruns. Runtime considerations: default sample_count=15 and perturbations are lightweight (token-level suffix/noise paraphrases). We include an escape hatch to run in 'fast' mode (sample_count=5) for PRs with time constraints. Risk and mitigation: adds nondeterminism but provides deterministic-seed override and deterministic replay; thresholds default conservatively to avoid unnecessary failures. Next steps: add visualization hooks in Console and surface cohort quarantine recommendations to the rollout tool. See related work ENG-4521 and incident notes SUP-1182 for background.

release_notes: Add stochastic consensus evaluator and CI bridge: new opt-in eval oracle that runs multiple perturbations per prompt to compute consensus-based stability metrics. Opt-in via eval config 'consensus.enabled'. Includes CircleCI gate adapter and guidance for tuning sample_count and thresholds. Improves detection of true regressions while reducing false positives from single-seed noise.
